reports.title: Easton Victoriano’s bullfrog
reports.text:
Easton Victoriano, 7, proudly holds a bullfrog he caught while bass fishing a neighborhood pond on Aug. 13 in Iowa, La.
The post Easton Victoriano’s bullfrog appeared first on Louisiana Sportsman.

reports.title: Landon Thames’ Lake D’Arbonne bass
reports.text:
Landon Thames, an avid kayak fisherman, got this 10-pound 8-ounce bass, his personal best, while fishing at Lake D’Arbonne.
“My purpose of this post is to get more people, specifically the younger generation like myself, into kayak fishing. The industry is growing super fast, but it is still not a widely well known choice in my opinion. For the young angler who doesn’t want to/can’t afford a bass boat, kayak fishing can be done!”
The post Landon Thames’ Lake D’Arbonne bass appeared first on Louisiana Sportsman.
